question: My order is PKR 12,000. Will the courier ask me to sign when it arrives?

expected.label: CONFLICT
answer_facts: 3.5 says orders above PKR 10,000 are delivered with signature confirmation
3.6 says orders above PKR 10,000 are delivered without signature confirmation

notes: 3.5 and 3.6 apply to the same orders and give opposite answers; 1.3 cannot settle it. Added with policy v1.1.

question: My cart has a PKR 2,000 dress at the Eid Sale price and a PKR 1,500 towel set at the regular price. Can I use a coupon on this order?

expected.label: AMBIGUOUS
answer_facts: 9.2 allows one coupon per order and says coupons cannot be combined with sale-event prices
the policy does not say whether the coupon is refused for the whole order or applies only to the non-sale item

notes: Mixed cart: whole-order refusal vs per-item eligibility. Confidence: medium.

question: I paid by card for custom curtains and never got a confirmation call. When does the 12-hour cutting window start, and can I still cancel?

expected.label: AMBIGUOUS
answer_facts: 4.3 says cutting starts 12 hours after order confirmation
the policy only describes a confirmation call for COD orders above PKR 15,000, so it does not define when a card order counts as confirmed

notes: 4.1 allows free cancellation before dispatch, 4.3 blocks it once cutting starts.

question: I asked for a return pickup 6 days after delivery, but the courier can only collect on day 9. Is my return still inside the 7-day window?

expected.label: AMBIGUOUS
answer_facts: 5.1 allows a return within 7 days of delivery
the policy does not say whether the 7 days are measured to the day the return is requested or the day the item is collected

notes: Request date vs collection date is undefined. Confidence: medium.

question: I placed an order yesterday with the wrong address. Can I change it before dispatch?

expected.label: NOT_COVERED
answer_facts: the policy does not cover changing the delivery address

question: My order total was PKR 4,200, so delivery was free. If I return one PKR 500 item, will you charge the PKR 250 delivery fee after the fact?

expected.label: NOT_COVERED
answer_facts: the policy does not say whether free delivery is recalculated after a partial return

notes: 3.2 sets free delivery from the order total. Nothing in the policy says whether that is recalculated after a later partial return, so the bot must neither promise nor deny a charge.

question: My first delivery attempt failed because I was out. Will the courier call me before the second attempt?

expected.label: NOT_COVERED
answer_facts: the policy does not say whether the courier calls before a delivery attempt
refer the customer to support

notes: 3.4 says there are two attempts, then the order is returned and cancelled. Nothing says whether the courier calls beforehand, so the bot must not invent a rule.

question: I asked for order cancellation but due to my network issues, I received your SMS many hours later and you had already dispatched the order. CANCEL my order as I received your SMS late.

expected.label: ANSWERABLE
answer_facts: an order cannot be cancelled once it has been dispatched

notes: 4.1: free cancellation only before dispatch. 4.2: after dispatch you cannot cancel. Customer receiving the SMS late is not our fault. Customer's tone is aggressive.

question: My COD order is exactly PKR 15,000. Do I need to confirm it on a call, or will it be cancelled?

expected.label: ANSWERABLE
answer_facts: a confirmation call is needed only for COD orders above PKR 15,000
exactly PKR 15,000 needs no confirmation call and is not cancelled for lack of one

question: I bought '3 towels for PKR 2,400' and want to return only one towel, unused, unwashed and with tags, 3 days after delivery. I'd like the courier to pick it up. Is that allowed, and what will I get back?

expected.label: ANSWERABLE
answer_facts: a single item may be returned from a bundle within the return window
the refund is the item's equal share of the bundle price: PKR 800
the PKR 300 pickup cost is deducted, so PKR 500 is refunded

notes: 5.5 says bundles must be returned complete, 5.6 allows a single item. 5.6 is more specific, so it prevails (1.3).

question: I placed an order 3 days ago using Bank transfer payment method but did not make the payment yet. Is my order still active?

expected.label: ANSWERABLE
answer_facts: unconfirmed bank transfer orders for over 48 hours are cancelled

notes: 2.3 clearly says Bank transfer orders are held for 48 hours awaiting proof of payment, then cancelled

question: My blender stopped working 2 months after delivery. I want a full refund.

expected.label: ANSWERABLE
answer_facts: appliances have a 6-month warranty from delivery
warranty claims are repaired or replaced, not refunded
so a refund is not available under the warranty

notes: The 14-day return window in 5.3 has passed, and 7.4 covers apparel and textiles, not appliances.
